claims.text: I once held the outright Premier League record for the most penalties scored without a single miss.
evidenceText: With twelve penalties scored out of twelve penalties taken, Palmer's goals in this match earned him the outright Premier League record for the most penalties scored without a single miss, surpassing Yaya Touré's previous record of eleven.

claims.text: Although I was part of a continental treble winning squad at Manchester City
evidenceText: An academy graduate of Manchester City, Palmer made his senior debut for the club in 2020, and was later part of their squad that won a continental treble of the Premier League, FA Cup, and UEFA Champions League in 2023.

claims.text: it was only after moving to Chelsea that I was named PFA Young Player of the Year.
evidenceText: He signed for Chelsea that year for a fee of £40 million and enjoyed a breakout debut season, earning multiple honours—including the PFA Fans' Player of the Year and Young Player of the Year awards.
On 20 August, Palmer was awarded the PFA Young Player of the Year award.
PFA Young Player of the Year: 2023–24

claims.text: I've played with the likes of Noni Madueke & Axel Disasi
evidenceText: In Chelsea's final match of 2023, away to Luton Town, Palmer scored twice for the first time professionally, while also assisting Noni Madueke's goal, as Chelsea won 3–2.

By assisting Axel Disasi's goal against Brentford on 2 March, Palmer became the Chelsea player with the most goal contributions in a season aged 21 or younger, overtaking Arjen Robben's tally of 16 contributions in 2004–05.
